topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series context and outlines the key learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective advantages that drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies and the cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the role of stem cell properties, hierarchical organization, and the cell of origin in tumor initiation and propagation across different cancer models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how non-mutagenic microenvironmental factors, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma enable tumor growth and provide therapeutic targets.

topics.label: Methods for investigating tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the experimental, sequencing, and computational technologies used to profile tumor cell plasticity and spatial microenvironments.

topics.label: Integrated evolutionary model of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes genetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors into a unified framework of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing remarks and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
